description: The fixed-rate plan with the lowest ESTIMATED annual cost in each Texas utility for the given usage (estimate from published Power to Choose prices incl. delivery, excl. taxes; not an offer — users should check the provider's EFL). Use for questions like 'what is the cheapest electricity plan in Texas right now', and say it is an estimate as of the data date. Free for non-commercial use with attribution; commercial use requires Pro.

charging_efficiency.description: Default 0.90 with ev_kwh_per_mile; 1.0 with vehicle (EPA figures include charging losses)

ev_miles.description: Optional EV: miles driven per month; adds home-charging kWh to every month (fixed-rate plans).

kwh.description: Average monthly usage in kWh (default 1000). Spread over a typical Texas year (summer-heavy).

months.description: Optional: 12 monthly kWh values, January first. Overrides kwh.

vehicle.description: Optional EV model id for its EPA efficiency (see electricity_ev_charging_cost), e.g. tesla-model-y-long-range-awd

name: electricity_cheapest
